notes.title: Attention! Achievements on the road!
notes.content:
Drivers!
First of all, thank you for your interest in Death Roads: Tournament. Practically a month has passed since the release, and during that time, you have taken part in an AMAZING number of races. You are the best!

[h2]Achievements![/h2]
To appreciate your efforts, we are introducing... [b]achievements[/b]. You asked for this, so there was no choice but to implement it! We hear all your voices, note your comments and consider your opinions. There are 53 of them, so drive (?) them all! In addition, we provide you with collector's cards, backgrounds, emotes, a badge - there's a lot of it on Steam.

[h2]Bugs![/h2]
We are also aware of the potholes that appeared after releasing the full version of Death Roads: Tournament. Therefore, in addition to the achievements, we are introducing a package of fixes to bugs you reported. [b]We really appreciate your commitment to making the race run smoothly.[/b]

[b]For example, what’s fixed?[/b]
[list]
[*] Garage View swap components with and without cards
[*] Draw pile and discard pile views stays empty if player draw exceeds draw pile
[*] Spotlight card does not change the direction of the attack
[*] Missing text on the component without cards
[*] Cards in players vehicle preview are overlapping
[*] World Map View can not display more scrap then 999
[*] Using cloud save on fresh account forces the player to go through cutscene and tutorial before continuing their run
[*] AC DC Voltmeter adds overload at the wrong moment
[*] Gadget Flask of oblivion does not apply Block satus
[*] In-Game the Reset Progress button does not serve its purpose
[*] The accumulator card does not grant overload apart from the first action
[*] Block generator add 1 block only at 8th drawn card
[*] Vehicle with more than 1 slot of same type causes issues with tooltip in rewards view
[/list]
And finally, we wish everyone [b]a successful end of the year[/b]. Remember to drive safely outside of Death Roads: Tournament!

notes.title: Death Roads: Tournament - Final Update Changelog
notes.content:
First of all, thanks for all your feedback folks! With it, we’ve been able to rework a lot of balance and difficulty issues. We’ve also added a bunch of new stuff that hopefully will improve your game experience and let you blow up your foes in new exciting ways.

Let’s run through the details below:

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Flexible movement range[/b] - You can now choose a distance you want to travel while performing movement actions stronger than 1. You can also skip any move action entirely while playing a card. This allows for more freedom with positioning. 
[*] [b]Handling regeneration[/b] - Enemies now regenerate handling at the start of the Player’s turn instead of their own. This way you can now limit the amount of cards the enemies will play during their turn, by reducing their handling without making them skid.
[*] [b]Weapon range highlights[/b] - When hovering over an enemy vehicle, you can now see the potential range of all its weapons. The highlighted range of a weapon card is also displayed on the board while hovering over a given weapon card in hand, so you no longer have to activate a card to see where it hits.
[*] [b]Twists and turns on the world map[/b] - The roads on the world map are no longer straight, and now look more like actual routes.
[*] [b]Unique body cards[/b] - The cards from the body components of all playable cars are now unique to each vehicle, and won’t appear in other components like engines, wheels or accessories. We’ve also reworked most of them to better emphasize different playstyles.
[*] [b]Different driver cards and starting gadgets[/b] - All playable drivers now have slightly different cards and starting gadgets, that create better synergies for a given playstyle. 
[*] [b]Reworked cards and components[/b] - Many of the existing cards and components were changed to be clearer and focus more on a given function in specific decks.
[*] [b]Reworked events[/b] - Events now offer better rewards and are less punishing for the Player. 
[*] [b]Reworked Challenger AI[/b] - Challengers in free for all battles can now attack each other instead of focusing only on the Player.
[/list]

[h3]Rebalance [/h3]
[list]
[*] Vehicles now have different equipment slot types, as well as new starting values of Condition, Armour and Bash Damage.
[*] Many components now give different modicator values.
[*] Some Gadgets values and effects have been changed. 
[*] Weapons should now deal more damage in general.
[*] Block and Grip status effects now appear more frequently on different cards.
[*] Rumble status effect stacks amount has been reduced, and its damage is now subtracted from the Block.
[*] Action to move in all directions now appears more frequently on cards. 
[*] Action to redraw cards now appears more frequently on cards.
[*] Push action now appears more frequently on cards.  
[*] Players now gain more experience points overall, and can progress quicker. 
[/list]

[h3]Added Content
[/h3]
[b]New Components[/b]
[list]
[*] A lot of new Engines, Wheels, Weapons, and Accessories were added. All tuned up, to fit and enhance a specific strategy.
[/list]
[b]New Gadgets [/b]
[list]
[*] Quite a few new options to gain MORE POWER!!!
[/list]
[b]New Drivers[/b]
[list]
[*] Tetsuo “4rg0” Yamauchi - The Wiz Kid, master of manipulation. 
[*] Alberto “Flamingo” Felluci - The ex-Mafia chauffeur, here to deliver pain. 
[/list]
[b]New Playable Car[/b]
[list]
[*] Torcia Olympic - Light yourself up in class, with this vintage recreation of the good old days just waiting to be ignited. 
[/list]
[b]New Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Three new Sedan type enemies
[*] Two new Buggy type enemies
[*] New Hot Rod type enemy
[*] New Pickup type enemy
[/list]
[b]New Road types[/b]
[list]
[*] Swamp Roads
[*] Mountain Roads
[/list]
[b]New Status effects[/b]
[list]
[*] Web - Take 2 Condition damage each time this Vehicle moves. Lose 1 Web at the end of your turn.
[*] Flat - Take 2 Condition damage whenever a Skid card is resolved by this Vehicle. Lose 1 Flat at the end of your turn.
[/list]

notes.title: Full release will hit the track in November
notes.content:
Hey there, drivers!
We've been quiet for a while, but it's not because we've been idling. [b]No, we've been carefully listening to your feedback on Steam and Discord, taking in every bit of your insights to ensure our game aligns with your wildest expectations.[/b] After all, you're the ones out there, burning rubber and navigating those insane roads.

[h2]Mark your calendars for the full release date: November 15th.[/h2]

The moment has come to bid adieu to our Early Access phase, and that's no small feat. This shift brought about a slew of changes, including some twists to our roadmap. [b]But fret not, for the majority of those exciting features and promises will indeed find their way into the game.[/b] And guess what? We've been doing more than just that. Get ready to see it all unfold very, very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/54c5c3acdead1aec5b139f7aa0ac58918b48d2d5.jpg[/img]

Death Roads: Tournament will receive full release on this pivotal day, officially graduating from Early Access. [b]What does this update have in store for you?[/b] Well, brace yourselves for new drivers and a fresh set of wheels. We're throwing in not one but two status effects and a truckload of new cards. Thanks to some fantastic biomes, we're even giving the game map a complete makeover.

Did you want challengers to fight each other? Then that's how it will be, too! Were you expecting support for Cloud Save? You will get it! [b]We've even spiced things up with a bunch of new gadgets and accessories.[/b] In short, we've been quite busy.

[h2]New features, but also changes in gameplay.[/h2]

But the real magic lies in the subtle touches. [b]We want Death Roads: Tournament to be more approachable without losing its hardcore edge.[/b] So, we've implemented many enhancements, like giving you a preview of your opponents' attack range and the ability to skip movements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/4a2156f9011b160f36b9885e629af17893db98f9.jpg[/img]

We've also fine-tuned the Skid Deck and made game events a tad more forgiving. All of this adds up to an entirely different and much more enjoyable gaming experience. [b]But hold your horses, we're not spilling all the beans just yet; you'll have to wait until November 15th to see it for yourself.[/b] And for those who've been battling motion sickness, don't worry, we've got your back, too.

We appreciate your unwavering support throughout the Early Access journey. [b]Remember, the race is far from over.[/b] So fasten your seatbelts because November 15th, we're hitting the gas pedal and leaving Early Access in the dust!

And all the best for Halloween! Cards-or-Skids for our drivers!

notes.title: Update 1: Roombos, Motorcycles and Motion Sickness
notes.content:
Hello there, drivers!
The first major content update for Death Roads: Tournament has arrived, and we know you'll like it. However, we warn you that [b]the whole thing has been made available in English so far[/b] - other languages ​​will be updated later. We prefer to let you know so that you are not surprised.

Also, if you see any bugs or other issues, let us know whether it's on Steam or [url=https://discord.com/invite/pQ6vqqGb2V]Discord[/url]. We are at your disposal, and we will be happy to help. Now let's get to the most important thing, which is what Update 1 hides!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/adebf1b650d7bb2a59b87a8af8b72f2ced9c1bf9.png[/img]
[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new tab in the settings menu, "Motion Sickness Settings", to address motion sickness issues experienced by some players. Players can now adjust parameters such as motion blur, camera shake, and the number of props appearing on the sidelines of roads to mitigate motion sickness. This is the first version of the solution, which will be further improved.
[/list]
[b]New Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introducing motorcycles and Roombo cleaning robots as new enemy vehicles players can encounter.
[*] Motorcycles are agile but deal low damage with their bashes and have limited durability. Each bike has a single-ranged attack with a limited range. Chopper fires short bursts to the sides while Cross throws grenades backwards through its left or right arm.
[*] Roombo cleaning robots have limited but versatile movement capabilities. Their signature attack pushes the player sideways, potentially pushing them into a wall. Beware of the more powerful Turbo Roombo version, which can heal itself by attacking the player.
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/76e192266812e1d5a2b5a0b7f55b871989941142.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/1b8588c1a906d6d32fb451b652187f47329bfd72.png[/img][/url]
[b]New Accessories:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new type of component that can be obtained and equipped in most playable vehicles. Some accessories provide positive modifiers, while others add unique cards to enrich the deck with specific functions, such as powerful status effects or strong movement actions. There are 24 of them in total. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/7975da0103daf4e059dc4cf16d365fd37130f5f9.png[/img]
[b]New Gadgets:[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded the pool of obtainable gadgets by introducing 25 new unique modifiers that enhance gameplay and encourage players to utilize existing game mechanics in new ways.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/4af3fc186e776f6a4bad4e0f1866ac59cf7e8965.png[/img]
[b]New Events:[/b]
[list]
[*] Included 12 new events that offer the opportunity to acquire gadgets, while others lead to unique encounters and battles.
[/list]
[b]New Wheels and Engines:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the variety of available cards and rewards obtained in battles and shops by introducing 8 new wheels and engines. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/98794651bbf65f7fe82efaf115792b6f96d0d5c3.png[/img]
[b]Bug Fixes and General Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Addressed various bug issues and improved overall game stability and performance.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the latest update and have an exhilarating experience in Death Roads: Tournament!

notes.title: Unveiling the Roadmap & Prologue of Death Roads: Tournament!
notes.content:
Today, we got two things to share with you: [b]the roadmap and the prologue[/b]. And let us give a big thanks for your unwavering commitment to the game's evolution. We've taken your suggestions and feedback to heart, ensuring that Death Roads: Tournament thrives just as you want it. Now, let's cut to the chase. What's in store for you?

[h2]Behold the Roadmap![/h2]

We are unveiling the roadmap that'll give you a taste of what awaits in the Early Access journey of Death Roads: Tournament. Some features have already been unleashed, while others are en route, and we're toiling away on even more, [b]lurking closer than you'd reckon[/b]. We reserve the right to throw in extra attractions and tweak the roadmap if the winds of change demand it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/30357a55da3d5b53e77d59eb6dc4757751e496d1.png[/img]

Brace yourselves for a wild ride with fresh faces behind the wheels and roaring machines. And mind you, the tracks are about to get crazier, with more adversaries crowding the roads. Don't reckon you're done after conquering the final boss, 'cause [b]a new menace[/b] lurks just around the bend. 

When the race pushes you to the edge, fear not! You'll have the option to kick back on an easier difficulty level, taking it easy on the gas pedal. But hey, we ain't forgetting about those plagued by [b]motion sickness[/b]. We're cookin' up a solution, my friends. Relief is on the horizon, ready to tame the unruly beast of nausea.

[h2]The Prologue - What's the buzz?[/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434090/Death_Roads_Tournament_Prologue/]The Prologue[/url] ain't a standalone game or a fancy project - it's a mere glimpse of the insanity that awaits in Death Roads: Tournament. So consider it [b]a demo version[/b], offering a tantalizing taste of the mayhem you'll savor in the full game. You'll take control of Maggie "Liberty" Murdock and her car, navigating through two different routes filled with a variety of enemies.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434090/Death_Roads_Tournament_Prologue/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/7364f8b409fbd908d048b5ff856b395e592595c4.jpg[/img][/url]

We want every soul in this barren land to give our game a shot, so we urge you to wishlist Death Roads: Tournament Prologue. In just [b]a two week's time[/b], it'll be yours for the taking, [b]absolutely free[/b]! Why even bother? In the fiery depths of the prologue, we've unleashed the initial antidote for the cursed plague of [b]motion sickness[/b]. It's time to rise above the waves of nausea and seize control of your destiny.

That's the message, fellow road warriors, for all you Steam players. Let the echoes of the wasteland carry the news of Death Roads: Tournament's latest offerings. Next week we will have some [b]more treats[/b] for you.

notes.title: Introducing Armor: your vehicle's new best friend
notes.content:
[b]Drivers![/b]
We're thrilled to announce the latest addition to our vehicular mayhem extravaganza: [b]the Armor[/b]! We've strapped on some heavy steel plating to your rides, ensuring that you'll be able to withstand the fiercest battles in the post-apocalyptic wasteland. 

[h2]What does the armor say?[/h2]

So, what exactly does this new stat do? [b]Well, think of Armor as your trusty shield against the perils of the harsh world.[/b] It's here to soak up all those nasty blows that would otherwise wreak havoc on your precious vehicle's Condition. Keep in mind, it's a component stat, not a card effect (Armor=/=Block) so you can pick parts with Armor to be… armored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/e4b199801d679b68c1bdceaad98a6a4dec0892a4.gif[/img]

As long as your Armor value is greater than zero, every bit of damage aimed at your Condition will be dutifully absorbed by your rugged Armor. But hold on; there's more! [b]Status Effect Block has higher priority than Armor.[/b] Once your Block has done its heroic duty, your Armor will step in to handle the rest, ensuring your vehicle remains battle-ready (Block>Armor>Condition).

Fear not when you kick off a battle, for your Armor will always be at its maximum value, just like your trusty Handling - you don't need scrap to repair it! [b]But remember, Armor has no use in events on the world map, so don't rely on it outside of fights.[/b]

What else can you expect from this update? We fixed a handful of bugs and made some localization improvements. Oh and yes, you can play right now!

Yours apocalyptically,
[i]The Dev Team[/i]

notes.title: Happy Easter! Curious about the update and roadmap?
notes.content:
Death Roads: Tournament kicked off last week, and, of course, it was not without fail start. Fortunately, our brave mechanics repaired the car, which finally stood on the starting line. Well, off we went, and you along with us, for which we thank you sincerely.

This week was a real no-holds-barred ride. [b]You have shown great interest in the game, shared with us accurate comments and provided us with plenty of suggestions.[/b] We take them all to heart and will even implement some of them.

[previewyoutube=tlzYxOT85oo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]First patch and the roadmap[/h2]

[b]Next week[/b], the first patch [i]*should[/i] be released, correcting several problems and fixing some bugs. For example, [b]we will lower the cost of healing[/b] - the full patch notes with all the changes will appear in a separate post. However, you need to know that this is just the beginning, and we intend to improve Death Roads: Tournament regularly: with your help!

Driver does not live by patches alone, so we will provide you with a roadmap [b]later this month[/b]. Thanks to it you will learn what we have hidden in the garage - you will not be able to complain about the lack of attractions. That's why we ask for a little more patience because it will be rewarded!

And finally, we wish you a happy Easter holiday. Rest and gain strength because the race continues!
[i]
*We reserve the right to delay - anything can happen on the road![/i]

notes.title: Without you this car will not race - feedback from playtests
notes.content:
[b]Hello drivers![/b]
[b]Thank you warmly for participating in the game testing on Steam at the end of last year! We received considerable positive and constructive feedback from you, which we analyzed in the sweat of our brow while planning further changes and improvements. We would like to share our conclusions and plans for the near future.[/b]

[h2]What went well?[/h2]

Let's start with the positives by mentioning that the overall difficulty and length of the game are satisfactory to you. [b]On a difficulty scale of 1 to 10, you rated the game an average of 8, which is very difficult.[/b] Most of the players did not reach the finishing line on the first try, which is ok because we aimed to make the game challenging. On the other hand, those who played longer could reach the final boss and beat it on average once every three attempts. The time of a full run was around 80 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/8e9f3f786e5e39bdc34a849853d4a7268d081331.jpg[/img]

According to those surveyed, the most common reason for losing was the limited ability to heal, but many were also unafraid to admit to making mistakes during gameplay. Among the players who spent the most time testing, there is a clear improvement in performance with successive approaches.

[b]We are pleased that among the answers to the question "[i]What do you think was the reason for winning?[/i]" the answer "[i]Synergy in the deck[/i]" had a clear advantage.[/b] In the question about favourite cars, drivers and sponsors, each item received a similar number of votes, which leads us to believe that many players will find among them a combination that creates a strategy unique to them.

[h2]It will be easier, but that doesn't mean easy![/h2]

A sizable number of players have reported the fact that a large jump in difficulty is felt between late-game and final boss fights. [b]We have spent the last few months bridging this gap, including increasing the number and variety of opponents featured in normal battles.[/b] We are also tweeting on an ongoing basis about cards, components, decks, and the behaviour of enemy vehicles based on the feedback we receive.

[previewyoutube=5V8X4Jx6L1U;full][/previewyoutube]

We've heard your requests and are making numerous UX and UI improvements, and working on more content. [b]In the Early Access version, you can expect more music, enemies, parts, and languages![/b] Yes, we are already working on localization for the languages listed below:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Portuguese
[*] Polish
[*] Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)
[/list]
We have also introduced a progression system, thanks to which new players should not be overwhelmed by the number of unique mechanics, and will be able to learn the game step by step unlocking more and more advanced content. This content will be gradually increased with subsequent updates of the game, the roadmap for which we will present at the start of the Early Access version in less than two months!

See you soon on the road!

notes.title: Dev Update #2 Tutorial or prologue? Why not both!
notes.content:
[b]Have you shifted gears in any other card game? Probably not. Just like many of our players during the Closed Beta testing. We collected your feedback and decided to make some changes; thanks to you! We hope they will help introduce new players to the basic assumptions of the game and, at the same time, serve as a quick intro to the world of Death Roads.[/b]

[h2]Not a boring tutorial. It's an active prologue![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/80627d76fd352d2c3afb264a8f735fecc1d2c24e.png[/img]
In addition to a few mechanics known from the roguelike genre, the game introduces some unique systems we haven’t met so far in other deck-builders. The most important are Gear shifts, the associated Skid, and the Bash. These mechanics will be the “main target” of our new tutorial on which we are working.

It will act as a prologue and take us to the times of tutorial Grandma’s youth - the final of the first edition of Death Roads: Tournament! Her older self, Margaret “Teacher” Murdock, will tell you about crazy adventures in this historic fight, sharing some tricks and commenting on the player's actions in dialogue bubbles.

[h2]Run the prologue once and get tired no more![/h2]
The prologue will guide the player through fundamental concepts such as using attack, move, Bash, Gear cards, allowing opponents to Skid etc. All within one turn, after which you can either finish the fight how you want or skip the rest of the prologue - it’s your choice. This is a separate game mode, available in the main menu, so you won't need to repeat it with each normal run! Or maybe you should? Who knows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/f2d5fa993fe9e8850965fd7fe85969393feb4a35.jpg[/img]
Several less essential mechanics, such as status effects or surface changes, will be contextually explained during the game when they occur for the first time. This will avoid a situation where we shower the player with too much information. The player will also have access to help screens, allowing him to recall the basic rules at any time during the game. We won’t leave you alone, no worries!

[h2]Little sneak peek
[/h2]
Finally, we wanted to present some text suggestions for the intro we plan to put at the beginning of the prologue. Please let us know what you associate it with and if it's not too cheesy :P. We'd love to hear from you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/6c592c0a27cde3d6bfe504ca180664bfcd73964f.png[/img]

“[i]Road… Road never changes… I mean, there are new potholes, new assholes, and the way may differ… but the Road… never changes. Each year, when the Hurricanes converge, it always leads to the same place. The finals at the gates of the great ECCT. Although not many are still alive to reach it in the end ...
Have I told you about the time when I was in my prime, battling the final stage of the first Death Roads Tournament?[/i]"

Stay tuned and keep your engines hot!

notes.title: Dev Update #1 Where will the road take us?
notes.content:
Welcome to Death Roads, drivers, the most dangerous race on this side of the Divided States of America. The Tournament may be going on, but we'd like to take a few moments before you participate.[b] It would be good to know where we are currently on the route, right?[/b]

As already announced, Death Roads: Tournament is approaching its release on Steam in Early Access. We are not revealing a specific date yet, but be sure that it is closer than further. As we promised, we will shower you with an absolute avalanche of information about the project, so be prepared!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/d4dad7dbee6713f2cb5ef624e5e035ee31af6a7a.png[/img]

[h3]What is the current development status?[/h3]

At this point, we can undoubtedly say that the core of the game has been tuned. Death Roads consists of three elements: progression on the world map, turn-based combat and deckbuilding. You choose your own path, compete with the opponents, and then choose rewards that will allow you to modify your vehicle in the garage. Along the way, you can get to the city, where you can come across, for example, another race participant who plays the role of a mini-boss, shops and fix stations where you can fix or upgrade your vehicle. That's it, in a nutshell. But is it true? You will find out about it by reading on!

[h3]What are the main features we are working on?[/h3]

We are currently expanding the race to provide more attractions and less repetition. You can also count on additional vehicles and drivers, new types of enemies, dialogue events and the Final Boss. The latter is the apple of our eye, and we want it to be really exciting.

We are also adding more music and enriching the world map while polishing some parts of the game and fixing bugs. So as you can see, work on Death Roads: Tournament is going on full throttle! Early Access is just the beginning of the race, and we plan to diversify it even more in the future.

[h3]What is the road plan? [/h3]

We plan to add new functionalities to differentiate the gameplay and give players new modifiers to get in the form of gadgets and sponsors to choose from at the beginning of the game. There will also be an unlock and achievement system. You can also count on "Driverpedia", where you can see your progress and get more information about your opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481305/d629cdf67834a9aae47345148af25d97a1d62b49.gif[/img]

Although Death Roads: Tournament is a turn-based production with cards, we want to reflect the realities of an actual, dangerous race. That's why we plan to add the weather mechanics over time and tell you the story of the tournament in an exciting way - because the last element is really important!

If you are hungry for details, [url=https://discord.gg/yqeJgV3FRY]check out our Discord[/url]. You will find first-hand information there, and we will also answer your questions. 

And see you in Death Roads!
